rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with an expanded blastocyst and acknowledges image limitations, but it overstates confidence in ICM/TE detail, suggests possible hatching not clearly visible, and repeats an inaccurate definition of Gardner 3 as fully expanded rather than full blastocyst.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, diagnosis, sperm parameters, endometrium, prior cycle, BMI, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a clear link from embryo/patient factors to prognosis; minor issues include somewhat speculative quantitative penalties and overconfident morphology-based conclusions from a single image.

Mostly aligned on SET and general IVF counseling, but includes weaker or controversial recommendations such as ERA after limited failure history, broad thrombophilia/immunologic workup, and somewhat overstated alcohol/stress evidence; also minor Gardner staging imprecision.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer, luteal support, hydrosalpinx confirmation, and future planning, though some suggested investigations are premature for this clinical scenario.
